capability: One owner for each fact that two copies share
title: Two copies, one card.

hook.picture: Close on the whale holding two cards, one marked script, one marked screen; it reads the same caption on both and the words differ.
hook.words: Wait, that is not what we wrote.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The script says one thing. The screen says another.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: researcher checking a film against its script

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the same caption lives on two cards; each edit fixes only the one in reach. Three-times device: three edits land, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each on one card only; the copies drift further apart.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each fix only changes one copy.

stakes.body: Learners read the screen, reviewers read the script, and neither knows the other is wrong.

solution_hint: Give each shared part one owner.

metaphor.body: Script, data, code and screen are four cards on one line. Wherever two repeat the same words is a join, and one owner card at each join is the copy the others follow.

steps.picture: Four cards ride the line, script, data, code and screen, with dashed joins between neighbours that repeat a caption.
steps.words: Give each shared part one owner.

steps.picture: The whale gives the data card an owner tab; at its join with the script, the dashed line glows terracotta where the words differ.
The script card's caption is rewritten from the owner; the join turns teal with a tick.
All three joins tick teal, and the name lands on the last one.
steps.words: Where copies meet, check: a seam.

real_case.claim: p5.js Explainer Lab audit R1, storyboard captions vs data.js captions: "Type-safe fails: 18 vs 20, with 6 text and 3 timing mismatches." The check (G7) is proposed, not yet built.

honest_limit.picture: Push in: both cards now match exactly, and both carry the same confusing sentence; the join ticks teal anyway.
honest_limit.words: Both copies agree. Both can be wrong.

not_this.body: Matching copies can both be wrong.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns: the whale holds the script and screen cards; their words are identical; the pod quotes the screen and answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The two cards that disagreed in bar 1 are back in the same hands, now saying the same words.

end_belief.body: One owner per fact. Copy from it.
